eyebrow: The fix: a subquery generates the list
code:
SELECT Name, ProductSubcategoryID
FROM Production.Product
WHERE ProductSubcategoryID IN (
  SELECT ProductSubcategoryID
  FROM Production.ProductSubcategory
  WHERE Name LIKE 'Mountain%'
);
caption: IN can return ANY number of rows — unlike Lesson 52's scalar subquery.
Traces back to Lesson 16 — NULL comparisons never resolve to TRUE.
